summary: Tested the iteration-11 Owner revision across backend and frontend. Backend: 13 of 13 new pytest cases pass, 1 skipped because openapi.json is not exposed. They cover /api/reports/operations for wastage, inventory, purchases and opname (all return 200 with rows and summary), invalid kind (400), missing params (422), no or bad token (401/403), sales report regression, and the create-user validation path (nothing persisted). Frontend at 390px: four Dashboard tabs are present. Dasbor Utama, Laporan and Dasbor Rider are fully visible at first and Gaji is offscreen. Horizontal scroll brings Gaji into view. The tab bar sits directly under the header (header bottom = tabs top = 64px). The active tab is #FF6B00 text with a #FF6B00 underline. Reports opened via the Dashboard category tab. All six report tabs switch with no page errors and no horizontal overflow. Operations reports show real zero values: Waste Rp 0 / 0 records, Inventory 27 zero-valued rows, Purchases 0, Opname 0 with accuracy '—', and an empty state where applicable. Desktop: each Owner category (Dashboard, Stock, POS, Production, Lainnya) shows the approved tabs. Clicking each tab routes correctly and exactly one tab is active. Settings has no Web/Tablet/Mobile controls. In the User Info dialog, the photo control accepts a file, shows an inline preview, and adds an inline data:image/jpeg;base64 photo to both the PUT (edit Owner) and POST (create) payloads. Both requests were intercepted and blocked; afterwards only baa exists and its photo is unchanged. The header avatar has text-black, border-2 border-black and is fully rounded. The logo is the orange crest. No yellow/gold hex values remain except a gradient in CoachChat.

minor.issue: UserCreateIn has no banks field and create_user hardcodes banks: []. Bank accounts entered in the 'Buat Akun' dialog are silently dropped on create.
The inline base64 photo has no size or format validation. Because the update loop skips None values, a photo can never be cleared once set.
start/end are required but ignored, since inventory is a current snapshot. The UI date filter on that tab misleadingly implies the period changes the result.

ui_bugs.issue: Initials avatar has text-black but no black circle border (border 0px), so it does not match the header avatar. On dark mode bg-primary/15 the black 'B' is almost invisible. RiderDashboard profile avatar (line 171) has the same text-black on dark bg-primary/15 problem.
The input has capture="environment", which forces the camera on mobile. A manual account photo should allow choosing from the gallery, so drop capture for this usage (e.g. an optional prop).

issues: The @username line uses text-muted-foreground gray on the orange header, which is low contrast. Use text-black/70.
Permissions 'Modules' still derives from the legacy NAV (5 modules) instead of the new CATEGORIES tabs.
The Apps Script URL field shows leftover test data 'https://script.example/TEST_2edffc' from a previous test run.
The 'reports' tab label renders 'Laporan Penjualan' while the approved name is 'Laporan'. The page now also holds Waste/Inventory/Purchase/Opname, so consider plain 'Laporan'.
Gradient still contains the yellow #ffc53d (5 occurrences). amber-500 is still used for warning states, which is acceptable as a semantic warning colour.

action_items: Add border-2 border-black to the UserInfo list avatar (and RiderDashboard avatar). Fix black-initial contrast in dark mode, e.g. a solid orange bg behind the initials.
Accept banks in UserCreateIn and persist them in create_user, or hide the bank section while creating.
Remove capture='environment' for the manual account photo input.

Optional: rename the reports tab label to 'Laporan'; hide the DateFilter for the inventory snapshot; fix header @username contrast; replace #ffc53d in CoachChat; clear the TEST_ Apps Script URL config.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1933 lines and should be split into routers (reports, users, auth).
Layout.jsx defines the class 'accent-border', which does not exist in CSS (dead class).

The Production category match uses location.search.includes('mode=production'), which works, but the Stock 'menuStock' NavLink ignores search. Both are fine today; just keep this in mind if the query changes.
Opname accuracy formula: 100 - sum|diff| / sum(max(before,1)) * 100 can go negative when diffs are large. Clamp at 0.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all requested flows pass; minor avatar border/contrast gap on UserInfo list)

test_credentials: Owner baa / PIN 130994 via identify -> login (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md)
seed_data_creation: None. User POST/PUT were intercepted via page.route and fulfilled with 400; DB still has only baa with no photo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login in Playwright can be done by fetching a token via API and setting localStorage 'si4am_token'. Only Owner exists. All transaction collections are empty, and the inventory report returns 27 zero-valued rows (18 materials + 9 menus). To test photo payloads without persisting, intercept **/api/users**. Brute-force lockout was not triggered to protect the Owner account.
rca of the issue: Bank accounts dropped on create: UserCreateIn (server.py ~224) lacks 'banks', and create_user sets banks: [] explicitly.
